name: Wrap
original_description: Wrap turns photos into reusable mockup templates. Ask for a realistic scene of any blank product, or share your own photo, and Wrap converts it while you watch. Then add your designs, adjust how they sit on the product, and export the mockup as an image. Your mockups are saved in your Wrap account, so you can reopen them in later chats or on wrap.design.
